payload.environment: Composer 2.5 Fast trace analysis of store discovery, worktrees, hooks, and CLI naming
payload.what_was_observed: 875 shell calls in traces used command adaptive-artifacts, unfunction, or explicit --store/--contract flags because ~/.zshrc defines adaptive-artifacts() forcing --store ~/.artifacts/$(basename toplevel), which breaks both repo-local stores and linked git worktrees (where basename changes to e.g. se-workflow--dashboard-approvals). Additionally, a stale cached plugin at ~/.cursor/plugins/cache/adaptive-artifacts/.../2ef49d70 ran session-start.py with pre-markdown store.py, read 0 .json records, and overwrote .artifacts/views/handoff.md and investigation-summary.md with _No matching records._.
